facilities.name: Solar
facilities.description: Produces only in daylight and usually peaks near sunny midday

facilities.name: Wind
facilities.description: Output changes with local wind and is often strongest in spring and fall

facilities.name: Natural Gas CC
facilities.description: Reuses the turbine's hot exhaust to raise steam for a second turbine, burning about a third less gas per MWh, but it is slow to start and ramp

facilities.name: Nuclear
facilities.description: Low direct emissions and steady output, but very slow to change

facilities.name: Coal
facilities.description: Runs on demand, with slow ramping and high direct emissions

facilities.name: Geothermal
facilities.description: Steady low-carbon output, but only at suitable underground heat sources

facilities.name: Natural Gas Peaker
facilities.description: A single gas turbine: cheap to build and running in minutes, but it burns about half again as much gas per MWh as a combined cycle

facilities.name: Battery
facilities.description: Quick to build and nearly instant to respond, with limited stored energy
